decisions.reason: This carrier wafer is a low-risk extension of the firm's core thin-wafer handling business and remains consistent with its direction toward reusable carriers and process-support substrates.

The copper interposer glass wafer is technically more demanding and commercialization may take time, but it fits the firm's stated focus on multifunctional packaging wafers and advanced semiconductor applications.
The off-the-shelf Wafer Universe line is very close to the established glass and quartz substrate business and should strengthen standard-product sales with limited strategic risk.

Glass-based circuit boards are relatively far from the firm's narrow core offer, so if traction is uncertain management would likely reallocate resources to core wafer products and nearer-term development projects.
